changelog:
v4.0.79+113 ROOT CAUSE FIX 2 ISSUES:
1) Bell infinite spinner when no messages: _isCheckingUpdate stays true forever if checkAppUpdate fails/timeout, shows CircularProgressIndicator forever. FIX: timeout 5s + safety 3s force false + beautiful empty UI with icon + message 'هیچ پیامی نیست' + cancel button.

2) Version shows old after install (FOREVER REGRESSION): Root causes found:
   a) download_apk.php hardcoded 4.0.75 everywhere, allowedGithubVersions only up to 4.0.75, so when 4.0.79 requested, it falls back to 4.0.75 old APK -> old version installed -> old version displayed (correctly, but old APK). FIX: dynamic version from app_release.json, allowed up to 4.0.79, fallback to 4.0.79.
   b) hardcodedCode 109 vs 111 vs 112 mismatch caused PackageManager versionCode check to think old is new.
   c) Single load from PackageManager cache returns old version immediately after install (Android cache). FIX: double load immediate + 1.5s delayed + clear prefs cache.
   d) pubspec.yaml + expectedVer + app_release.json version mismatch.
   FIX: All versions synced to 4.0.79+113, download_apk.php dynamic, double PackageManager load, cache bypass ?v=&t=&r=, GitHub direct first.

✅ Bell now shows beautiful 'no messages' UI, ✅ Version now correctly shows new after install.
